items.title: 長榮物流部分資訊系統遭攻擊，啟動資安防禦與復原機制
items.summary: 11月12日物流及貨運服務公司榮運（2607）於股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，長榮物流部分資訊系統遭受駭客攻擊，伺服器出現異常情形，公司隨即啟動資安應變措施因應，目前資訊系統已恢復正常，初步評估對公司財務及業務並無重大影響。

items.title: 泰航、芬蘭航空因Amadeus資安事件外洩逾6萬、11萬旅客資訊
items.summary: 泰國航空（Thai Airways）及芬蘭航空（Finnair）周一（11月9日）公告， 訂票服務系統供應商Amadeus遭到非法存取，分別導致超過6萬及11.6萬筆乘客記錄可能外流。

items.title: 大金空調零件線上商城委外廠商發生資安事件，141筆訂單資料受波及、132筆個資遭未授權存取
items.summary: 和泰車（2207）11月12日下午於股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，子公司和泰服務行銷的委外服務廠商順立智慧（Cyberbiz）發生資安事件，導致旗下大金空調零件線上商城的資料庫部分內容遭未經授權存取，目前掌握共有141筆訂單資料受到波及，其中涉及132筆個人資料。

items.title: 大聯大發生資安事件，部分員工姓名與公務電子郵件遭未經授權存取
items.summary: 11月12日半導體通路商大聯大（3702）於股市公開資訊觀測站發布重大訊息，該公司偵測到內部系統出現異常存取情形，經調查確認，部分員工姓名及公務電子郵件地址遭未經授權存取，公司已立即啟動應變程序，並採取必要防護措施，初步評估對公司財務及業務均不受影響。

items.title: 憂AI助長網攻及生物武器風險，美國非營利組織控告OpenAI等5家業者
items.summary: 美國4家非營利組織周四（11/12）聯合提告，指控OpenAI、Google、Meta、Anthropic及SpaceXSI開發的先進AI系統可能失去人類控制，助長網路攻擊及生物武器擴散，要求法院凍結相關模型的開發。

items.title: AI讓攻擊進入自動化時代，Google：企業更要管好Agent權限
items.summary: 一場網路攻擊，從取得受害系統的存取權限，到透過多個AI Agent協同執行攻擊，最後大規模蒐集存取憑證，可能不到六小時就能完成。攻擊者不再只是逐步尋找漏洞、手動執行攻擊，而是利用AI串聯不同階段的工作，在短時間內擴大攻擊規模。 Google威脅情報小組（Google Threat Intelligence Group，GTIG）技術長Shane Huntley指出，AI並未從根本上改變網路攻擊的本質，卻讓攻擊者能以更快的速度、更大的規模執行既有攻擊。過去受限於人力與時間，攻擊者必須選擇目標；如今AI可以協助搜尋漏洞、分析系統及執行攻擊，企業原本認為風險不高的弱點，也可能成為入侵入口。

items.title: refactor(agents): tidy workspace access checks and setup tests (#196302)
items.summary: refactor(agents): tidy workspace access checks and setup tests (#196302) * fix(agents): keep a Template Add BOOTSTRAP.md until the agent removes it (#91931) Template Add seeds BOOTSTRAP.md before it writes the template's profile files, so the next workspace preparation saw a customized SOUL.md, recorded setup as complete and deleted the template's bootstrap before the agent ran. Record provenance in one nullable workspace_setup_state.bootstrap_supplied column that Template Add sets with its seed (in-process and worker paths). Only the write that wins the initial seed owns it, and Template Add rollback clears it with that attempt's seed. A supplied bootstrap completes only once it is removed. Unmarked workspaces, including existing rows (NULL), keep today's completion rules and profile-only recovery. Test consolidation keeps the change net-negative in lines. * fix(state): add bootstrap_supplied on first Template Add use, not at startup As a startup column, bootstrap_supplied was missing from every older state database, so the bounded version migration declined them and startup fell back to the full repair. That repair created lazy tables (agent_provenance) and recomputed acp_replay_sessions byte counts, which the historical migration scope proofs correctly rejected. Make it a first-use column instead: only the write that wins a supplied Template Add seed adds and sets it, other setup writes never touch it, and rollback clears it only where it is set. Opening or upgrading a database leaves workspace_setup_state unchanged.

items.title: fix: compaction fails for sandboxed sessions with selected skills (#1…
items.summary: fix: compaction fails for sandboxed sessions with selected skills (#198029) fix(compaction): keep the loaded skill snapshot for sandboxed sessions For sandboxed sessions with selected skills, compaction replaced this turn's loaded skill snapshot with the saved copy, which deliberately leaves out runtime catalogs, then failed with "Selected skill snapshot must be hydrated before sandbox delivery." Automatic compaction gave up, the next turn hit a context overflow instead of a reply, and sessions.compact returned compacted false. Automatic compaction now uses the turn's already-loaded skills, and the direct compaction path reloads the saved copy in memory through the existing skill snapshot loader. What compaction keeps, drops or writes, the saved snapshot and skill selection are unchanged. No new text. Evidence: a built Gateway in a secretless node:24.22.1 container with an SSH sandbox, a stand-in model with a 32k context window and a selected Skill Library skill, main twice and candidate twice. On main automatic compaction failed with the hydration error, the next turn got a context overflow, and sessions.compact returned compacted false. With this change compaction completes, sessions.compact returns compacted true and the next turn answers with the skill still in the prompt. A non-sandboxed session with the skill and a sandboxed session without skills behave the same on both, and the stored skill snapshot is byte-identical before and after every compaction. The regression folded into the existing preflight test fails without the fix, at -4 net test lines. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198029#issuecomment-6842306282. Thanks @jason-allen-oneal. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
